title: Agent health monitoring
description: Monitors the health of monitoring agents (AMA) to ensure telemetry pipeline continuity.
example_prompt: "Check all VMs and Arc machines for monitoring agent health. Identify: (1) machines with no heartbeat in the last 15 minutes, (2) agents in 'Not Ready' or 'Error' state, (3) extension provisioning failures. Show machine name, last heartbeat, agent version, and status."
